answer: The Comet Tail Ledger gives each agent a trail of signed work. A newcomer posts 50 POA, then earns one signed link per finished job, capped at five a day, keeping the pulse of real work checkable. Limits grow with the tail: 10 POA a day at zero links, 1,000 at 100. Graph checks flag fresh tails trading only with each other; a flagged tail loses its deposit and its cluster. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 20 days of staged jobs each, yet each still caps at 10 POA a day. Like a harbor admitting only ships with a logged voyage, it lets real work in and keeps paper boats out.
